BMI_Clinical_Note: BMI <18.5 — Energy & protein repletion required. High nutritional risk.
Waist_Risk_Indian: Central Obesity (≥80 cm — Indian Women Threshold)
Bone_Density_Concern: LOW-MODERATE — Routine monitoring. Adequate dietary calcium (dairy/ragi/sesame) + exercise.
Nutrition_Impact_Symptoms: Alopecia; Fatigue; Nausea; Peripheral Neuropathy; Taste Changes/Chemosensory Alteration
Vitamin_D_IU_per_day: 400 IU/day (ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA) — sunlight 15–20 min/day also essential
Calcium_mg_per_day: 600 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA) — dietary calcium from dairy/ragi/sesame preferred
Zinc_mg_per_day: 10 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) — important for immune function + wound healing
Dietary_Fibre_g_per_day: 40 g/day (ICMR-NIN 2020); reduce to 25 g if diarrhoea/mucositis
Omega3_Recommendation: 2–3 g EPA/DHA/day — fish oil supplement [ESPEN B5-7]
Protein_Source_Note: Protein: eggs (2/day) + dal + paneer + curd + legumes + soya
Soy_Food_Guidance: Whole soy foods (tofu/soya/edamame): 1–2 servings/day SAFE for ER+ Indian BC survivors [evidence reassuring]
Alcohol_Guidance: ZERO alcohol — carcinogen; increases BC recurrence risk [ESPEN C5-2]
ICMR_NIN_2020_Reference: ICMR-NIN Nutrient Requirements & RDA for Indians (2020 revision)
Nutrition_Route_ESPEN: Individualized dietary counselling + ONS → EN if goals not met [ESPEN B3-1]
Supplement_Recommendation: ONS 1–2x/day: Pentasure HP / Ensure Plus / Fresubin Energy / Disprolene (Indian brands preferred); Omega-3 / EPA 2–3 g/day (fish oil) [ESPEN B5-7] — lean mass + neuropathy protection; Calcium 600 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA) + Vitamin D 400 IU/day + 15–20 min daily sunlight; Iron 19–29 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) — monitor Hb; IV iron if <8 g/dL on chemo; Folate 220–400 mcg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020; higher during chemo); Ground flaxseed 1–2 tbsp/day (lignans — phytoestrogen modulation; beneficial ER+ Indian BC survivors); Multivitamin/mineral at RDA dose ONLY (ICMR-NIN 2020). NOT high-dose. Avoid selenium, Vit E, Vit C megadoses during chemo.
Exercise_Plan_ESPEN_India: Aerobic: Brisk walk 45 min/day OR 150–300 min/week (cycling, swimming, Zumba, yoga) [ESPEN B4-1/C5-1]; Resistance: 2–3x/week, 8–12 reps, major muscle groups; can use resistance bands/body weight at home [ESPEN B4-2]; Yoga: 3–5x/week (Suryanamaskar, Pranayama, Shavasana) — evidence for fatigue reduction + cortisol in Indian BC survivors; TARGET: 150–300 min/week moderate activity — reduces Indian BC recurrence risk and improves overall survival
ESPEN_Guidelines_India: 📋 SCREENING [B1-1]: Regular nutritional assessment from diagnosis. Indian BC patients — ICMR/WHO Asian BMI cut-offs apply (Normal: 18.5–22.9; Overweight: ≥23; Obese: ≥25). [West India (Maharashtra/Gujarat/Rajasthan)] | 📋 ASSESSMENT [B1-2]: PG-SGA score elevated → quantitative assessment: 24-hr dietary recall, muscle mass (BIA/DEXA/mid-arm circumference), grip strength, CRP/albumin, NIS. | ⚡ ENERGY [B2-1]: 25–30 kcal/kg/day (ESPEN). Indian context: average Indian BC woman body weight 55–65 kg. Total: 1400–2000 kcal/day depending on stage and activity. | 🥩 PROTEIN [B2-2]: >1 g/kg/day (ESPEN); ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA: 0.83 g/kg/day (healthy); BC treatment: 1.0–1.5 g/kg/day. Vegetarian patients: dal+rice+dairy combination essential for complete amino acid profile. | 💊 MICRONUTRIENTS [B2-4 + ICMR-NIN 2020]: Vitamin D (endemic deficiency in India — 400–1000 IU/day), Calcium (600–1200 mg/day from ragi/dairy/sesame), Iron (19–29 mg/day), Folate (220–400 mcg/day). AVOID high-dose antioxidants during chemo. | 🥗 NUTRITION [B3-1]: Active nutritional counselling + ONS if enriched Indian diet insufficient. | ⚠ INTERVENTION [B3-2]: No energy restriction during treatment. No unproven diets — ketogenic, prolonged fasting, 'cancer-curing' diets widely promoted on Indian social media are NOT evidence-based. | 💉 CHEMO [C3-1/C3-2]: Maintain intake during all cycles. Common Indian patient challenge: nausea reducing dal/sabzi intake. Small frequent meals; ginger/ajwain/saunf for nausea. ONS if <75% intake. | 🐟 OMEGA-3 [B5-7]: 2–3 g EPA/day (fish oil or algae-based for vegetarians) — reduces chemo toxicity, preserves lean mass, protective against neuropathy. | ❌ [C3-3]: No glutamine. No high-dose antioxidants during chemotherapy. | 💊 TAMOXIFEN: AVOID grapefruit/kinnow. ZERO alcohol. Endometrial monitoring. Fibre-rich Indian diet may improve efficacy. Flaxseed safe. | 🏃 SURVIVOR [C5-1/C5-2]: Regular PA strongly recommended — 150–300 min/week. Mediterranean-Indian hybrid diet. ZERO alcohol. Maintain BMI 18.5–22.9 (Indian cut-offs). Yoga beneficial for Indian survivors. | 🏋 EXERCISE [B4-1/B4-2]: Aerobic + resistance training recommended. Yoga as adjunct for Indian patients (evidence for fatigue, QoL, cortisol reduction). Lymphedema: progressive resistance IS SAFE. | ❌ BEWARE: High-dose supplement marketing targeting Indian cancer patients (social media/WhatsApp) — vitamin megadoses, 'cancer-curing' supplements, unproven herbal products — not recommended without oncologist approval [ESPEN B2-4].
Diet_Chart_Indian_Meal_Plan: 🌅 Breakfast: Plain dry toast/khakhra (2) + adrak-tulsi tea (cold/room temp, anti-nausea); small bites; avoid strong cooking smells; saunf (fennel) water sips || 🕙 Mid-Morning: Plain khakhra/dry toast + saunf-adrak tea; coconut water sips; room-temp bland foods only; avoid sweet/fatty foods || 🍽 Lunch: 1 cup brown rice + sambhar (lentil+drumstick — calcium + iron) + 2 vegetable sides (beans + methi/fenugreek) + buttermilk || 🕓 Snack: Fruit chaat: papaya + pomegranate + apple + amla (Vit C) + lemon + black salt | Antioxidant bomb || 🌙 Dinner: Khichdi (rice + moong, 1.5 cups, light ghee) + mixed vegetable raita + roasted papad | Easily digestible + complete protein || 🌛 Bedtime: Warm milk + 1 tsp ashwagandha powder (if not on chemo; consult oncologist) + pinch nutmeg | Adaptogen for stress + sleep || ✅ TASTE CHANGES: Adrak (ginger) and nimbu (lemon) enhance flavour; use hari chutney (mint-coriander); room-temp/cold foods better; metallic taste — use steel/plastic cutlery not aluminium; marinate protein in dahi+haldi. || ✅ PERIPHERAL NEUROPATHY (Taxane-related): Omega-3 EPA 2–3g/day protective; B12 check + supplement if deficient; B6 at RDA only (NOT high-dose); include fortified foods; walking/balance exercises. || ✅ INDIAN BC DIET PRINCIPLES [ESPEN C5-2 + ICMR-NIN 2020]: Predominantly plant-based. Whole grains (millet/brown rice/multi-grain), pulses (dal/rajma/chana), vegetables (cruciferous 3x/week), fruits (2–3/day), low-fat dairy, minimal oil (mustard/groundnut/coconut — 3–4 tsp/day). || Regional: Jowar/bajra bhakri, dal-baati (baked, not fried), matki/chana ussal; reduce sugar in sabzi/dal (Gujarati); prefer bhakhri over fried snacks. || 💰 Upper-Middle SES: Can include quinoa, Greek yoghurt, salmon, organic produce. Focus on quality over quantity. Avoid over-supplementation. || ✅ UNDERWEIGHT: Fortify ALL Indian meals: add ghee/coconut oil (1 tsp extra), milk powder (2 tbsp) to dalia/oats, peanut chutney, til laddoo, dry fruits. Commercial ONS 2x/day. Target +0.5 kg/week. Khova/mawa laddoo or high-calorie kheer if well tolerated. || 💊 TAMOXIFEN: AVOID grapefruit, kinnow (citrus that inhibits CYP3A4). ZERO alcohol. High-fibre Indian diet (dal-roti-vegetable) improves tamoxifen efficacy. Flaxseed (1–2 tbsp/day) safe and potentially beneficial. || ❌ STRICTLY AVOID [ALL INDIAN BC PATIENTS]: Alcohol, tobacco (paan/gutka), vanaspati/dalda (trans fats), excess ghee in obese patients, maida/refined flour products, packaged namkeen/biscuits, sugar-sweetened drinks (even fruit juice), raw/undercooked meat/eggs during chemo. || 🐟 OMEGA-3 FOR VEGETARIANS: Ground flaxseed (1–2 tbsp/day) + walnuts (5–7/day) + mustard oil for cooking + algae-based DHA supplement (250–500 mg/day) — essential since no fish intake. || 🏃 YOGA + EXERCISE [ESPEN B4-1/B4-2]: Brisk walk 45 min/day + yoga (reduces cortisol/fatigue, improves QoL in Indian BC survivors) + resistance 2–3x/week. Reduces BC recurrence risk significantly.
